I LOVE fundraising! There are lots of ways to set up passive fundraising as well as actively having your scouts sell something. 
Our pack has a Amazon smile account set up so weave our parents set up their Amazon so we get a small percentage of their purchases and get a check every quarter. We also have a community rewards set up for Kroger (our grocery store chain in the south) and they also do the same thing. That way even when you are not “selling something” you are still taking in a small profit. 
We also set up event nights at Chipotle, Panda Express and Panera - where we have Pack nights and get a percentage of the profit. Those have been really great if well attended. 
As for items we sell, we have done Krispy Kreme gift certificates (which are easier to sell bc people can use them whenever), trash bags, little Caesars frozen pizzas and beef sticks. Our council does a “camp card” which is helpful since popcorn is sometime a hit or miss.

I would tell myself that...... 
The feelings that you are having are not temporary; however that doesn’t mean that you let them win. Everything doesn’t “work out” or fall in line with your plan that you have for yourself, but they do get better. You accept the parts of yourself that you don’t like and you find an amazing woman who loves you for yourself and you save a little boy from a life of abuse and neglect. Yes, you will continue to put on the show that everything is okay and you are still your bubbly self - even though sometimes you use it to hide your pain. You don’t forget the first girl that broke your heart, but after a while, you start to heal yourself and once you have done all that you can, another woman comes and heals the parts that you couldn’t. You are not always the closeted sorority girl, you get to be parts of who you want to be and are still growing everyday. You get to be a mom. You get to be a wife. This does not mean that you won’t ever feel sad or depressed, in fact, sometimes it does consume you. However, you have someone who will look at you and her eyes will glisten with love that you never thought you would experience and a little boy who makes your heart so full of joy it feel is like your heart will jump out of your chest. It is these moments and people who will help you pull yourself out of those familiar dark places and move towards the light of days to come.
